text: When the king woke up. <break time="0.8s" /> In the morning a strange bearded man. <break time="0.8s" /> Was looking at him. <break time="0.8s" /> From the bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Forgive me. <break time="0.8s" /> The man said in a weak voice. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not know you. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> To forgive you for answered the king. <break time="0.8s" /> You do not know me. <break time="0.8s" /> But I know you. <break time="0.8s" /> I am your enemy. <break time="0.8s" /> And I swore to take revenge. <break time="0.8s" /> On you. <break time="0.8s" /> You put my brother to death. <break time="0.8s" /> And took away my land. <break time="0.8s" /> So I have hated you. <break time="0.8s" /> Ever since. <break time="0.8s" /> When I heard. <break time="0.8s" /> That you had come alone to the hermit. <break time="0.8s" /> I hid in the woods. <break time="0.8s" /> To attack you. <break time="0.8s" /> On your way home. <break time="0.8s" /> But you did not come back. <break time="0.8s" /> So I came out to look for you. <break time="0.8s" /> And your bodyguards recognized me. <break time="0.8s" /> And wounded me. <break time="0.8s" /> I escaped from them. <break time="0.8s" /> But I would have died. <break time="0.8s" /> If you had not cared for my wound. <break time="0.8s" /> I wanted to kill you. <break time="0.8s" /> But you have saved my life. <break time="0.8s" /> Now I will serve you faithfully. <break time="0.8s" /> And so will my sons. <break time="0.8s" /> The king was very glad. <break time="0.8s" /> To make peace with his enemy. <break time="0.8s" /> So easily. <break time="0.8s" /> And he forgave the man at once. <break time="0.8s" /> He also promised. <break time="0.8s" /> To send his own doctor and servants. <break time="0.8s" /> To him and to give back his property.
